labels.description: A `Tensor` of the same type and shape as `logits`, with values between 0 and 1 inclusive.
constraints: same type and shape as logits
logits and labels must have the same shape

logits.description: A `Tensor` of type `float32` or `float64`, any real numbers.
constraints: type: float32 or float64, any real numbers
logits and labels must have the same shape

pos_weight.description: A coefficient to use on the positive examples, typically a scalar but otherwise broadcastable to the shape of `logits`. Its value should be non-negative.
constraints: coefficient to use on the positive examples, non-negative

output.description: A `Tensor` of the same shape as `logits` with the componentwise weighted logistic losses.

constraints: logits and labels must have the same shape
